svg.title: How a pixel becomes a sound
svg.desc: 1. The pixel under the needle in NASA's frame. 2. Its colour, read back on the frame's own colour bar: 29.8 °C. 3. A written rule: -5 to 35 °C becomes 220 to 880 Hz, so 29.8 °C is 735 Hz, panned by longitude. 4. The sound, made live, with a caption. Checked against NASA MUR SST: 0.31 °C median error.
